# Calendar interface replacements retain caller-specific exception and compartment limits

The original wrapInstance helper caught failed QueryInterface calls and returned null. Its removal uses different operations for different callers, so optional access or instanceof is not a blanket equivalent. The fixed cached-calendar getter catches QueryInterface and explains its add-on compartment constraint. The fixed CalDAV redirect catches its optional upload probe before requiring HTTP interfaces. These later contracts stay separate from the original removal. No add-on, redirect or cross-compartment result was tested.

Scope: Calendar wrapper-removal compatibility scope.
